meanings: to collect/congregate/gather, put together, complete. thubaat (acc. pl. of thubatun, which is the f. of thuban/thubayun) - in separate companies, groups, detachments, parties. To praise/honour/magnify/mention (e.g. a collection of good points). Many nouns in the f. sing. as here lose their third radical when it is ha/waw/ya.

occurrences.verseArabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا خُذُوا حِذْرَكُمْ فَانْفِرُوا ثُبَاتٍ أَوِ انْفِرُوا جَمِيعًا
occurrences.verseTransliteration: Yâ eyyuhellezîne âmenû huzû hızrakum fenfirû subâtin evinfirû cemîâ(cemîan).
occurrences.verseMeaning: Ey inananlar! Savunma tedbirlerinizi alın. Gerektiğinde de bölükler halinde hareket geçin yahut toplu halde savaşa çıkın.
